title: רב חנין בריה דרב ייבא

paragraphs: Rav Chanin, son of Rav Yeiva. Rava said, “Who is as wise as Rav Chanin son of Rav Yeiva?”: Bava Batra 174a. So too Asheri and Rif. Yuchasin lists Rav Chana bar Yeiva in Rav's time. Sheerit Yosef, among Rav's students, lists Rav Chani bar Rava. I have not found mention of him; perhaps it is a scribal error and should read bar Yeiva, the aforementioned Rav Chanin. But this Rav Chanin lived in Rava's generation; how could they write him among Rav's students? Yuchasin likewise wrote that he lived in Rav's time. Rava also said, “Who is as wise as Rav Chinena son of Rava of Pashrunya?” See Rav Chiyya bar Yeiva above; perhaps they are one person.
